sources.note: Homepage describing Medplum as open-source healthcare developer platform. Lists key customers (Ro, Summer Health, Thirty Madison, CDC), claims 20M+ patients. Describes core solutions: custom EHR, patient portal, provider portal.
ONC certification page for Medplum v5, certified 12/31/2025. Lists 24 certification criteria covering clinical documentation, orders, care coordination, data exchange, and security.

Documentation hub covering FHIR modeling (charting, questionnaires, care plans, scheduling, messaging, medications, labs, billing), development tools (bots, SDKs, React components), integrations (HL7, Health Gorilla, DoseSpot, SMART, C-CDA, FHIRcast).

Products page describing clinical data platform (CDR, APIs, search, subscriptions), integrated services (forms, scheduling, e-prescribing, labs, revenue cycle), development tools (auth, React library, bots, SDKs), and enterprise infrastructure.

Case studies page listing Summer Health (pediatrics/SMS), Ro Diagnostics (labs), Rad AI (radiology), Develo (pediatric billing), Chamber Cardio (cardiac), Flexpa (claims), Tia (women's health), Rewind, Titan Intake.

EHI export mechanism documentation. Returns FHIR bundle of all Patient Compartment resources plus referenced resources (Organizations, Practitioners, Locations, Medications, Devices). Supports date/type filtering.
YC S22 batch. Founded 2021, 12 people, San Francisco. Founders previously built MedXT (YC W13, acquired by Box). Described as API-first open-source EHR.
GitHub repo with 2.1K stars, 157 contributors, 500K+ Docker downloads. Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, AWS CDK. Latest release v5.0.14 (Feb 2026).

2025 review: v5 launch, IHE IRA radiology certification, Drummond EPCS certification, MCP server for AI, 1462 PRs, PlumCon 2025 conference. Expanded integrations for HIE, medications, and revenue cycle.

2026 plans: HITRUST certification, HTI-4 compliance, enterprise sharding/Kafka, enhanced scheduling, provider app improvements, plugin ecosystem, revenue cycle/prior auth, AI infrastructure (MCP, copilots, scribes).

Third-party description of Medplum as open-source headless EHR. Lists features: FHIR-compliant EHR, scheduling, billing/claims, telemedicine, patient portal, developer APIs. Target: primary care, specialty, virtual-first clinics.
